build_dataset_builder: build an evaluation dataset builder that retrieves datasets from HuggingFace and saves processed records to disk
create_hf_source: create an HFSource model with a repo_id, optional revision, and optional HuggingFace token for dataset retrieval
retrieve_input_dataset: retrieve an input dataset from HuggingFace or S3 and return the local path to the downloaded data
save_to_disk: save dataset records to disk in chunks with optional HTML visualization for each document
get_effective_indices: get effective begin and end indices for processing a subset of items from a dataset
